es.q: Discuss the anatomy of the coronary circulation and the consequences of proximal occlusion of the right coronary artery.
es.m:
- **Origin:** The left main and right coronary arteries arise from the left and right sinuses of the aortic root distal to the aortic valve.
- **Left Main Division:** Within 2.5 cm, it divides into the left anterior descending artery (LAD) and the left circumflex artery (CX).
- **RCA Supply:** The right coronary artery (RCA) supplies the RA, RV, and infero-posterior aspects of the LV.
- **Nodal Supply:** The RCA supplies the SA node in about 60% of individuals and the AV node in about 90% of individuals.
